ops.rpt.note.bookings.basis: Bookings are placed in the period by the date chosen above. Checkouts that were started but not finished are counted in “Started” only.
ops.rpt.note.bookings.conversion: Conversion = confirmed ÷ started. Cancellation and no-show rates are shares of confirmed bookings.
ops.rpt.note.bookings.lead: Lead time is how long before the trip starts the booking was confirmed.
ops.rpt.note.bookings.rates: Cancelled and no-show bookings are counted on the same date basis as the rest, not on the day they were cancelled.
ops.rpt.note.common.change: The change compares with the period shown above. Green means good for the business, red means bad — a falling cancellation rate is green. Shares change in points.
ops.rpt.note.common.timezone: Days start and end at midnight in the time zone shown. When a report covers branches in several time zones, the one most branches use is applied.
ops.rpt.note.fleet.blocked: Rentable days are the days vehicles were in the fleet minus the time they were blocked for maintenance or damage.
ops.rpt.note.fleet.current: The fleet is the fleet as it is today; vehicles that have since been retired are not included.
ops.rpt.note.fleet.earned: Earned revenue is each trip’s price without tax, spread over the days of the trip — a trip that crosses the end of a period earns in both.
ops.rpt.note.fleet.formula: Utilisation = rented days ÷ rentable days. Average daily rate = earned revenue ÷ rented days. Revenue per available day = earned revenue ÷ rentable days.
ops.rpt.note.fleet.home: Vehicles are counted at their home location.
ops.rpt.note.operations.counted: A pick-up is counted on the day and at the branch where the keys were handed over; a return where the car came back.
ops.rpt.note.operations.damage: Damage is what return inspections found and what was charged for it.
ops.rpt.note.operations.late: A return is late when the car came back more than one hour after the time on the agreement.
ops.rpt.note.operations.settlement: Charged at return is the extra amount settled when the car came back (fuel, late fees, damage).
ops.rpt.note.overview.where: Each headline figure comes from the report that defines it — open that report for the detail.
ops.rpt.note.payments.cash: Collected and refunded are counted on the day the money moved, whatever the dates of the booking.
ops.rpt.note.payments.failed: Failed attempts are payments that were declined or could not be completed; their amounts are not counted.
ops.rpt.note.payments.tax: Tax invoiced is the tax on invoices issued in the period, net of credit notes.
ops.rpt.note.payments.unpaid: Unpaid balances is what confirmed and completed bookings still owe right now; it does not depend on the period.
ops.rpt.note.sales.adr: Average daily rate = revenue ÷ rental days. A rental day is 24 hours of a booking.
ops.rpt.note.sales.ancillary: Extras & protection are the optional items added to a booking; “Bookings with extras” is the share that has at least one.
ops.rpt.note.sales.basis: A booking is placed in the period by the date chosen above: the day it was confirmed, the day the trip starts, or the day it ends.
ops.rpt.note.sales.lost: Lost value is the total price of bookings that were cancelled or became no-shows. It is not part of revenue.
ops.rpt.note.sales.net: Revenue is the price of confirmed and completed bookings without tax. Tax is shown separately and is never part of revenue.
